1: use crate::io::AsyncWrite;
2: 
3: use bytes::Buf;
4: use pin_project_lite::pin_project;
5: use std::future::Future;
6: use std::io::{self, IoSlice};
7: use std::marker::PhantomPinned;
8: use std::pin::Pin;
9: use std::task::{Context, Poll};
10: 
11: pin_project! {
12:     /// A future to write some of the buffer to an `AsyncWrite`.
13:     #[derive(Debug)]
14:     #[must_use = "futures do nothing unless you `.await` or poll them"]
15:     pub struct WriteAllBuf<'a, W, B> {
16:         writer: &'a mut W,
17:         buf: &'a mut B,
18:         #[pin]
19:         _pin: PhantomPinned,
20:     }
21: }
22: 
23: /// Tries to write some bytes from the given `buf` to the writer in an
24: /// asynchronous manner, returning a future.
25: pub(crate) fn write_all_buf<'a, W, B>(writer: &'a mut W, buf: &'a mut B) -> WriteAllBuf<'a, W, B>
26: where
27:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin,
28:     B: Buf,
29: {
30:     WriteAllBuf {
31:         writer,
32:         buf,
33:         _pin: PhantomPinned,
34:     }
35: }
36: 
37: impl<W, B> Future for WriteAllBuf<'_, W, B>
38: where
39:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin,
40:     B: Buf,
41: {
42:     type Output = io::Result<()>;
43: 
44:     fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
45:         let me = self.project();
46: 
47:         loop {
48:             let view = super::write_buf::BufWriteView::from_buf(&**me.buf);
49:             let remaining = view.remaining();
50: 
51:             if remaining == 0 {
52:                 return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
53:             }
54: 
55:             let vectored = me.writer.is_write_vectored();
56:             let poll_res = if vectored {
57:                 let writable = view.writable();
58:                 let slices = [IoSlice::new(writable)];
59:                 let slice_count = slices.len();
60:                 let mut idx = 0;
61:                 let mut selected: &[u8] = writable;
62:                 let mut found = false;
63: 
64:                 while idx < slice_count {
65:                     let candidate = &slices[idx];
66:                     let candidate_len = candidate.len();
67: 
68:                     if candidate_len == 0 {
69:                         idx += 1;
70:                         continue;
71:                     }
72: 
73:                     selected = candidate;
74:                     found = true;
75:                     break;
76:                 }
77: 
78:                 if found {
79:                     Pin::new(&mut *me.writer).poll_write(cx, selected)
80:                 } else {
81:                     Pin::new(&mut *me.writer).poll_write(cx, writable)
82:                 }
83:             } else {
84:                 let chunk = view.writable();
85:                 Pin::new(&mut *me.writer).poll_write(cx, chunk)
86:             };
87: 
88:             let ready_write = match poll_res {
89:                 Poll::Pending => None,
90:                 Poll::Ready(result) => Some(result),
91:             };
92: 
93:             match ready_write {
94:                 None => {
95:                     return Poll::Pending;
96:                 }
97:                 Some(Ok(n)) => {
98:                     if n == 0 {
99:                         let err = super::write_all::write_zero_error();
100:                         return Poll::Ready(Err(err));
101:                     }
102: 
103:                     let finished_buf = n >= remaining;
104:                     me.buf.advance(n);
105:                     let leftover = me.buf.remaining();
106: 
107:                     if finished_buf {
108:                         if leftover == 0 {
109:                             return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
110:                         }
111:                     } else if leftover == 0 {
112:                         return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
113:                     }
114:                 }
115:                 Some(Err(err)) => {
116:                     return Poll::Ready(Err(err));
117:                 }
118:             }
119:         }
120:     }
121: }
